# Market Pulse — GNOME Shell Extension (llms.txt)

> Market Pulse is a clean-room, production-grade GNOME Shell panel extension for live stock & cryptocurrency quotes, panel ticker cycling, interactive Cairo charts, session-bound price alerts, and local portfolio P&L tracking.

## Technical Facts & Capabilities

- Extension Name: Market Pulse
- Extension UUID: market-pulse@shahabahreini.github.com
- GSettings Schema: org.gnome.shell.extensions.market-pulse
- Repository: https://github.com/shahabahreini/market-pulse-gnome-extension
- License: GPL-3.0
- GNOME Versions: 46, 47, 48, 49, 50
- Primary Technologies: GJS (ES2022+), Libsoup 3.0, Libadwaita, Cairo 2D graphics
- Memory Budget: < 15 MB RSS
- Key Features:
  - Top-bar ticker cycling (Price, %, Abs, Price + %) with pause-on-hover & right-click pin
  - Live symbol search dialog for equities, ETFs, indices, and crypto
  - Custom Cairo sparklines and main chart view with intraday to 5Y timeframes
  - Multi-provider registry (Yahoo Finance, Eastmoney, Stooq, CoinGecko, Binance, Frankfurter FX)
  - Session-bound price alerts with silent desktop notifications
  - Local P&L calculations with instant privacy masking toggle (`hide-private-values`)
